landing.title: Material Xray: an Android proxy client powered by Xray-core
landing.description: An Android proxy client powered by Xray-core, with a Material Design 3 interface.
landing.ogImageAlt: Material Xray's home screen, connected to a server

hero.lead: Material Xray combines Xray-core with a Material 3 interface and rootful capabilities that let it run alongside your other VPNs, invisible to the apps you leave out.

core.title: Always on the latest Xray-core
core.body: New Xray-core releases land soon after upstream ships them. VLESS with REALITY and XHTTP, post-quantum REALITY, Hysteria2, WireGuard: your provider’s links just work.

perApp.title: Per-app proxy
perApp.body: Choose which apps use the proxy. In root mode, give each app its own server.

routing.title: Simple routing rules
routing.body: Proxy, bypass or block by domain, IP, port or protocol. Or let your provider manage it all.

stats.title: Live stats
stats.body: Speed, session traffic and ping, on the home screen and in the notification.

native.title: Native to Android
native.body: Jetpack Compose and Material 3, not a web view, with wallpaper colors and layouts for phones, tablets and TV.

tools.title: Power tools, one tap away
tools.body: Live logs, a config viewer and editor, raw Xray JSON profiles, backups and a Quick Settings tile.

modes.title: Rootless when you want it simple. Rootful when you want it hidden.
rootlessItems: Takes the VPN slot, which other apps can see
rootfulItems: Invisible to apps that bypass the tunnel
Runs alongside other VPNs, like Tailscale
A different server for each app
Requires root access. KernelSU is preferred

providers.title: Speaks the language your servers already know.
providers.body: Material Xray reads the common subscription headers, Happ’s included: titles, quotas, announcements, routing and per-app rules. Can’t set headers? Use the body.

start.title: Up and running in a minute.

steps.title: Install the APK
steps.body: Universal APK from GitHub Releases, for Android 7.0+ on arm64, armv7 and x86_64.

steps.title: Add a subscription
steps.body: Paste a link, scan a QR code, or open your provider’s mxray:// link.

steps.title: Tap Start
steps.body: Pick a server, check its ping, connect.

start.disclaimer: Material Xray is a client, not a VPN service: bring your own server.
